1.zh: 說人家有房才敢生，你拿什麼娶小雯，哈哈
1.en: She said people only dare to have kids once they own a home, so what are you marrying Xiaowen with, haha

1.en: I put the ring back in the drawer for now

2.en: Zhihao hasn't messaged the group in a long time...

2.zh: 小雯媽媽拿有房那張問我，人家有房才敢生，你拿什麼娶小雯。戒指我放回抽屜裡了。
2.en: Xiaowen’s mom hit me with the own-a-home poster: people only dare to have kids once they own a home, so what are you marrying Xiaowen with. I put the ring back in the drawer.

ask.en: Parental leave can now be taken by the day.

group.en: Yan, holding my case with you pls 🙏

group.zh: 真好，我當年只能一次請完
group.en: Nice, back then I had to take it all at once

1.en: My team lead threw that poster back at me: no need to apologize, sure, but then who takes responsibility for the case?

1.zh: 半天假被記在考績上了啦，真的不好意思

1.en: Lao Yan, I’m leaving my case on your desk for now 🙏

self.zh: 同學都留在畫面裡，妳的生活被裁掉了
self.en: Everyone stayed in the picture. Your life got cropped.

gone.zh: 宣傳照張張漂亮，天燈少了好幾盞
gone.en: Every poster looked great. Several lanterns never went up.

mix.en: No one was spared, not even you.

阿芳: 升主任了。小芋頭下午有人接，不是我。
Made director. Someone picks up Little Taro afternoons, not me.
回事務所了，主任沒升。小芋頭會自己走回家了。
Back at the office, no promotion. Little Taro walks home alone now.
家豪: 小太陽四十八個，招牌還亮著。
Little Sun has 48 kids, sign still shining.
小太陽剩三十個。招牌我自己補漆。
Little Sun down to 30. I repaint the sign myself.
宜君: 三萬二。今年暑假帶媽去沖繩，只請到三天。
32k. Taking Mom to Okinawa this summer, only got 3 days off.
志豪: 還沒存到八十萬，下個月先求婚。戒指拿出抽屜了。
Haven't saved 800k yet, proposing next month. Ring's out of the drawer.
還在存。小雯說她不急，我急。
Still saving. Xiaowen says she's not rushed, I am.
佩珊: 孩子會叫媽媽了。請假單還是先寫不好意思。
Baby says mama now. Still start my leave note with sorry.
請假還是會道歉。孩子很好。
Still apologize for leave. Kid's doing good.

阿芳: 小芋頭明年抽到公幼。我回事務所上班，三十五歲升主任。
Little Taro wins a public preschool spot next year. I go back to the firm and make manager by 35.
家豪: 「小太陽」招生滿 60 個。爸寫的招牌要撐過第 30 年。
“Little Sun” fills all 60 places. Dad’s hand-painted sign makes it to year 30.
宜君: 月薪從 26,000 變成 30,000。暑假帶我媽去沖繩，機票先訂了。
Pay goes from 26,000 to 30,000 a month. Taking Mom to Okinawa this summer, tickets already booked.
志豪: 九點前下班。存到 80 萬頭期款，買得起才敢跟小雯求婚。
Off work before 9. Save an 800k down payment, then I can finally propose to Xiaowen.
佩珊: 三十歲前生第一個。請假不用跟任何人道歉。
First baby before 30. Taking leave without apologizing to anyone.
